title: Research Paper Assistant Workflow
short_description: A structured prompt-chaining workflow for source-grounded literature review: NotebookLM grounds answers in uploaded papers, Claude reasons and drafts, and ChatGPT formats. Inputs, outputs, responsibilities and tool-access boundaries were defined, along with academic-integrity rules and evaluation cases. It is a workflow, not an autonomous agent.
detailed_description: A workflow for helping with repetitive research tasks while leaving relevance, accuracy, and judgment to the researcher.

facts.label: Problem
facts.text: Academic research means switching between tools for literature review, summarization, drafting and citation organization, while every claim must stay grounded in real papers.

facts.label: Approach
facts.text: A prompt-chaining workflow: NotebookLM grounds answers in uploaded PDFs, Claude reasons and drafts, and ChatGPT improves formatting. It is a workflow, not an autonomous agent.

facts.label: Methods
facts.text: Academic-integrity rules, five evaluation cases, risks and guardrails, and a four-iteration build log. The MVP was evaluated for citation accuracy, unsupported claims, summarization quality and formatting.

facts.label: Outcome
facts.text: An MVP tested on five research papers. Human verification remains necessary. Zotero integration, GitHub storage and automatic citation management are planned and not implemented.

rows.label: Implemented
rows.text: Academic-integrity rules and five evaluation cases

rows.label: Tested
rows.text: MVP run on five research papers

rows.label: Planned
rows.text: Zotero integration, GitHub storage, automatic citation management (not implemented)

rows.text: Human verification of citations and claims
